purpose: Independent acceptance expectations for representative original-era fabric and declared normal-use operation. Not a verified individual building or regulatory certification.

policy.nominal_comparison_convention: Compare matching physical envelope roles (walls, thermal top, windows) and nominal forward U-values with declared surface films. Ground floors and basement walls are not compared: ground heat transfer is modelled by epsm_core / epsm_rc. Missing or contradictory physical definitions remain blocking.
policy.density_comparison_convention: Compare only compatible material families and explicit kg/m3 bases; abs(thermal density - source density) / source density. Never modify a thermal property to satisfy a carbon mapping.

severity_policy.error: Contradictory or invalid supplied data, failed acceptance reference, or worsening intervention.
severity_policy.missing: Required catalogue definitions, material data or acceptance inputs absent; unknown is never a numerical zero or a pass.
severity_policy.review: Context or construction judgement required; not a certification or automatic rejection.

sources.project_policy: User-approved Catalogue sanity-check rules; tolerances are project screening policies, not Swedish regulatory limits.
